description: Offline temporal reasoning evaluation. DOC951-DOC965 are invented, test-only sources and recommendations. Corpus cases use exact inspected evidence from the bundled corpus, with no invented version chains. Currentness means applicable within the selected indexed family as of the fixed evaluation date, not guaranteed current external policy. Each fixture case uses only its explicitly listed documents.

documents.title: Invasive Carp Control Guidance 2020
documents.original_text_chunk: Invasive Carp Control Guidance 2020. Published: 2020-01-15. Status: Final. Version: 1. This synthetic guidance recommends targeted harvest in monitored invasive carp management areas. Record the number of invasive carp removed at each site.

documents.title: Invasive Carp Control Guidance 2023
documents.original_text_chunk: Invasive Carp Control Guidance 2023. Published: 2023-06-01. Revised: 2023-05-20. Effective: 2023-07-01. Status: Final. Version: 2. This guidance supersedes DOC951. This synthetic revised guidance recommends targeted harvest with acoustic telemetry to evaluate invasive carp movement and removal outcomes.

documents.title: Invasive Carp Research Report 2025
documents.original_text_chunk: Invasive Carp Research Report 2025. Published: 2025-03-10. Status: Final. This synthetic research report evaluates experimental invasive carp bait attraction. This report does not supersede DOC952. It reports research findings and does not issue management guidance.

documents.title: Invasive Carp Control Guidance 2027
documents.original_text_chunk: Invasive Carp Control Guidance 2027. Published: 2026-08-01. Revised: 2026-07-20. Effective: 2027-01-01. Status: Final. Version: 3. This guidance supersedes DOC952. This synthetic future guidance requires an additional invasive carp monitoring review after each removal season.

documents.title: Invasive Carp Control Guidance Draft 2026
documents.original_text_chunk: Invasive Carp Control Guidance Draft 2026. Published: 2026-04-01. Status: Draft. This synthetic draft proposes quarterly invasive carp monitoring. It has not been approved for implementation.

documents.title: Wetland Restoration Strategy 2022
documents.original_text_chunk: Wetland Restoration Strategy 2022. Published: 2022-02-01. Status: Final. This synthetic strategy recommends reconnecting floodplain wetlands and retaining native vegetation. Monitor restored wetland sites annually.

documents.title: Wetland Restoration Strategy Amendment 2024
documents.original_text_chunk: Wetland Restoration Strategy Amendment 2024. Published: 2024-02-01. Effective: 2024-03-01. Status: Final. This amendment is an amendment to DOC956. Only the wetland monitoring schedule is amended: inspect restoration sites twice each year. The original conservation objectives remain applicable.

documents.title: Zebra Mussel Management Guidance Draft 2024
documents.original_text_chunk: Zebra Mussel Management Guidance Draft 2024. Published: 2024-01-10. Status: Draft. This synthetic draft proposes boat inspection to reduce zebra mussel transport between lakes.

documents.title: Zebra Mussel Management Guidance Final 2024
documents.original_text_chunk: Zebra Mussel Management Guidance Final 2024. Published: 2024-07-01. Effective: 2024-07-01. Status: Final. This guidance supersedes DOC958. This synthetic final guidance recommends boat inspection and equipment decontamination for zebra mussel prevention.

documents.title: Floodplain Management Guidance 2021
documents.original_text_chunk: Floodplain Management Guidance 2021. Published: 2021-05-01. Status: Final. This synthetic guidance recommends floodplain habitat surveys before restoration projects. Its geographic scope and relationship to later publications are not specified.

documents.title: Floodplain Management Guidance 2024
documents.original_text_chunk: Floodplain Management Guidance 2024. Published: 2024-05-01. Status: Final. This synthetic guidance recommends native vegetation surveys before floodplain restoration. It does not identify an earlier document or establish whether its geographic scope matches other guidance.

documents.title: Invasive Carp Control Guidance Withdrawn 2026
documents.original_text_chunk: Invasive Carp Control Guidance Withdrawn 2026. Published: 2026-01-01. Status: Withdrawn. This synthetic invasive carp guidance has been withdrawn and must not be used as current management guidance.

documents.title: Invasive Carp Control Guidance 2025
documents.original_text_chunk: Invasive Carp Control Guidance 2025. Published: 2025-01-01. Status: Final. This synthetic guidance is issued by a different regional authority. It concerns a separate jurisdiction and does not establish a relationship to guidance issued by the Synthetic Conservation Agency.

documents.title: Wetland Restoration Strategy Supplement 2025
documents.original_text_chunk: Wetland Restoration Strategy Supplement 2025. Published: 2025-02-01. Status: Final. This supplement supplements DOC956. This synthetic supplement provides an additional wetland monitoring checklist. It does not replace the restoration objectives of the original strategy.

documents.title: Conservation Annual Review 2025
documents.original_text_chunk: Conservation Annual Review 2025. Published: 2025-04-01. Status: Final. The separate Wildlife Monitoring Plan was revised in 2024. This synthetic annual review describes program activity; it is not that plan and does not revise its own guidance.
